{
  "findings": [

      "severity": "blocker",
      "claim": "Acceptance criterion 2 says reconcile reads a task's re-gate for \"the rows in READY_FOR_REVIEW, APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED or EXHAUSTED that carry a pr_url,\" but that is not every row reconcile asks GitHub about: a NOT_IMPLEMENTED row with a pr_url (attached by saffron adopt) is also asked about, via MERGE_ONLY_STATES, and reconcile.py's own comment says so (\"EXHAUSTED and NOT_IMPLEMENTED are askable too, below, through MERGE_ONLY_STATES\"); CONTEXT.md's Adopt entry confirms reconcile asks GitHub about an adopted NOT_IMPLEMENTED task's pull request. The witness drives nine rows (six READY_FOR_REVIEW, one APPROVED, one EXHAUSTED, one CHANGES_REQUESTED) and never a NOT_IMPLEMENTED+pr_url row, and no wrong_versions entry names this gap, so a build that reads the closed four-state list literally and skips the regate read for NOT_IMPLEMENTED would wrongly omit reporting a re-gate for a real, already-documented case, and nothing here would catch it.",
      "criterion": 2,

    },

      "severity": "concern",

The described behavior at each location still holds true at this snapshot, but the pointers themselves cannot be trusted at face value, and an operator should decide whether that matters before a cell starts.",

Since all three named witness files fall under tests/**, the size_gate at this snapshot would now measure near the 307-token source-only figure rather than 1131, which keeps the diff safely under the 3000-token feature ceiling either way but means the estimated_lines: 283 figure (1131 divided by four) is derived from a total the current gate would no longer reproduce.",
